sourceReview.PendleSwap.sol: Adds immutable REFUND_RECEIVER set by the constructor and transfers the entire remaining input-token balance to it after each swap. Kyber scaling, approvals, upgrade authorization, swap enum and every imported dependency are unchanged from the exact October17 reviewed source.
sourceReview.economicBehavior: Unused input is transferred to the fixed receiver, not returned to the user. Exact-input fixtures must independently reconcile swap input events, ERC20 transfers, swap balances and actual receiver balance deltas; transaction input swept to that receiver must be zero. Existing output-floor, collateral/debt, allowance and authorization checks remain mandatory.
sourceReview.refundReceiverAttribution: Observed immutable destination; external ownership or protocol accounting attribution is not established by this review.
sourceReview.abiChanges: Constructor gains refundReceiver and a REFUND_RECEIVER() getter; swap(address,uint256,SwapData) and SwapSingle event shapes remain unchanged.
sourceReview.officialRepositoryLimitation: Official pendle-core-v2-public main source fetched October23 still predates this deployed version. Reproduction uses verified explorer source and exact live runtime, rather than claiming the public main branch contains the upgrade.
sourceReview.unpinnedSimpleFacetBranch: Looping buy validation requires guessOffchain>0 and rejects canonical zero-guess calldata; the independent Simple selector remains outside the allowed dependency surface.

semanticFindings.behavior: Immediately before SY.redeem, stores the immediate Router caller in transient namespace slot 0xe8cb61b87f041ce7ba1d7b88bf113ca84d0bcb904414c3716402eebd313d5c00; clears it after successful redemption. Reverting calls roll back transient writes. Uses no persistent state.
semanticFindings.integration: Bundler routes expose GeneralAdapter1 as the immediate caller, not the wallet owner. Existing output min, receiver, transfer, and approval rules remain in force. Compatibility must be proven for each admitted SY using the production compiler fork.

semanticFindings.behavior: requestBurnQuota only emits caller/token/amount/optData; burnAccount returns transient redeemer caller. Existing 18 method inputs, outputs, and mutability remain unchanged.
Nonempty optData now decodes (uint256 version, bytes payload), requires version 1, then decodes normal/flash payloads. Empty 0x remains valid.
semanticFindings.integration: OpenPendle builds empty LimitOrderData; loopingExecution.assertEmptyLimitOrderData rejects fills and nonempty optData. No admitted route encoding change required.

semanticFindings.behavior: Deprecated ODOS slot 2 becomes reserved; slots 6 and 7 name PARASWAP and ZEROX. NONE=0 and KYBERSWAP=1 unchanged.
semanticFindings.integration: Regular app routes use NONE; reviewed looping routes accept NONE direct or pinned KYBERSWAP only.

semanticFindings.behavior: Self-directed transferOut becomes a no-op; balance helper extracted; unused math casts/clamp and interface functions added. Permitted path transfer/approval recipients and financial arithmetic are unchanged.

actionableFindings.finding: guessOffchain=0 can select swapExactTokenForPtSimple through self-delegatecall, which lies outside the currently pinned facet set.
actionableFindings.recommendedFix: Require a positive guessOffchain for reviewed looping buy routes, and test rejection of the zero-hint case without broadening the pinned facet dependency set.
actionableFindings.status: Implemented by parent: positive guessOffchain guard and explicit zero-hint rejection fixture independently inspected in working tree
